rationale: The dev's spec already covers same-folder clone, identity preservation, cross-folder routing, and cancel (all WIRED). Two corrections are needed, both edits inside the existing file: (1) 'should clone a composite whose child alert was deleted' passes vacuously because delete of a referenced child is refused 409 child_referenced (mod.rs:2157-2168) and alerts-api-helpers.js:233 swallows the error — convert it to a test.fixme (UNWIRED). (2) The WIRED behavior 'clone is always created disabled' (service.rs:312) has no assertion — extend the identity test to seed the source composite enabled and assert the clone is disabled. No new spec, so no ci_matrix re-registration.
